synopsis: Star Wars: What is a Wookiee? is a Star Wars book by Laura Buller and Kate Simkins that was published by Dorling Kindersley at reading level 1. It is hosted by C-3PO, who describes the Star Wars universe in a form accessible to small children. A canon reissue of the title was released on January 19, 2015 with new cover artwork and additional cover spreads throughout the book, adding 16 pages of content not found in the previous edition
title: What is a Wookiee?
